# Subiquity schema fixture

`autoinstall-schema-26.04.1.json` is the unmodified `autoinstall-schema.json`
from Canonical's Subiquity [26.04.1 tag](https://github.com/canonical/subiquity/blob/26.04.1/autoinstall-schema.json).
SHA-256: `beb72fefb590af5dfaaa615f6836c56fd74451f31b21dca631cb8c414f45a2ae`.
Subiquity is copyright Canonical and contributors and distributed under GPL-3.0;
see [SUBIQUITY-LICENSE](SUBIQUITY-LICENSE). The four cloud-config fixtures are
generated by this project's constructor with a password used only for tests.

`interactive-user-data` and `serial-user-data` retain their original bytes.
`desktop-user-data` exercises the desktop fields, static networking, a local
mirror, SSH, software options and a completion script. `offline-user-data`
uses ISO-only installation with no archive requirements. These fixtures use
disposable test credentials and do not prove a real client install completed.
